articles.summary: Auna Delivers Solid Financial and Operating Performance in Peru and Colombia, While Advancing Key Initiatives in Mexico Auna (NYSE: AUNA) (“Auna” or the “Company”) , a leading healthcare platform in Latin America with operations in Mexico, Peru, and Colombia, announced today financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2025 (“third quarter 2025” or “3Q25”). Financial results are expressed in Peruvian Soles (“S/” or PEN”) and are presented in accordance with International Financial
articles.title: Auna Announces 3Q25 Financial Results
